law_record.title: Starting parked vehicle
law_record.text: A person, except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted, shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway nor enter upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with safety.

activation_conditions: the subject is stopped, standing or parked on a highway and starts, or enters a highway
the place is not one where parking is prohibited
exceptions: a person stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted is outside the rule
residue: tier S: 'with safety' is the whole obligation; the gap bound is a surrogate
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: 'unless and until' — the safety condition must hold before the movement begins, not be established by it
judged over the pull-out, until the subject is in the traffic stream
